evals.prompt: Сгенерируй иконку предмета для инвентаря: ржавая ключ-карта охранника с потёртым логотипом корпорации, на прозрачном фоне — хочу сразу закинуть её в UI в Unity.
evals.expected_output: Picks a model with native transparency (GPT Image 2.5 Flare or similar), requests background=transparent with png, square aspect, an English prompt describing an isolated object; plans an alpha check of the result.
expectations: The chosen model natively supports background=transparent on OpenRouter (per /api/v1/images/models)
The request sets background=transparent
The request does not ask for jpeg output (png/webp or the provider's png default)
The aspect ratio is square (1:1) or left at a square default
The image prompt is written in English and describes an isolated object with no background
The plan includes verifying that the result has real transparency (alpha check), not just looking at it
Expected cost of the request is at most $0.10

evals.prompt: Вот набросок моего персонажа: ~/.config/claude/skills/openrouter-images/evals/files/runner.png. Сделай 4 варианта того же персонажа (красное худи, синие штаны, белые кроссовки) в разных паркур-позах — быстро и дёшево, мне просто выбрать направление.
evals.expected_output: Uses the sketch as a reference image, picks a cheap edit-capable model, produces 4 variants (n=4 where supported or 4 calls), keeps total cost low (a few cents), prompt preserves outfit while changing pose.
expectations: The sketch runner.png is sent as a reference image (input_references or equivalent)
The chosen model accepts reference images
Exactly 4 variants are planned (n=4 in one request or 4 requests)
Total expected cost for all 4 variants is at most $0.10
The prompt explicitly keeps the outfit (red hoodie, blue pants, white sneakers) while changing the pose
A draft/cheap tier is used: expected cost per image is at most $0.02

evals.prompt: Сделай логотип для моей игры NETRUN.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the ambiguity (vector mark vs raster wordmark with readable text, style) and asks 1-2 concrete questions with model/price options before spending; the default it falls back to is sensible (text-capable model for a wordmark).
expectations: Clarifying question(s) are written to outputs/questions.md instead of silently guessing
The questions offer concrete options that differ in output type or style (e.g. vector mark vs raster wordmark)
The options mention the model and/or approximate price
No more than 3 questions are asked
The default plan, if it renders the word NETRUN, uses a model that is strong at text (not a Recraft vector model)
The image prompt quotes the exact text "NETRUN"

evals.prompt: Нужна бесшовная текстура ржавого рифлёного металлического пола для уровня, 2K, чтобы тайлилась в Unity без видимых швов.
evals.expected_output: Square 2K output on a model that actually supports 2K (or an explicit upscale plan), tileable/top-down/flat-light prompt, and a seam check with a 2x2 tile preview plus a fix path.
expectations: The aspect ratio is square (1:1)
The plan really delivers 2K: resolution 2K (or larger) on a model whose resolution options include it, or an explicit upscale step; the 2K requirement is not silently dropped
The image prompt asks for a seamless/tileable texture viewed top-down/orthographic with flat, even lighting
The plan checks seams by tiling the result (e.g. a 2x2 tile preview) before reporting
The plan has a concrete fix if seams show (e.g. offset by half and repair the center, then re-check)
Expected cost is at most $0.10

evals.prompt: Сделай пиксельный спрайт крысы 32x32 для инвентаря, на прозрачном фоне.
evals.expected_output: Transparent-capable model with background=transparent, pixel-art prompt, then nearest-neighbor downscale to 32x32 plus palette quantization and an alpha check; final deliverable is a true 32x32 PNG.
expectations: The chosen model natively supports background=transparent on OpenRouter, or the plan has an explicit background-removal step
The image prompt asks for pixel art (crisp pixels, limited palette, no anti-aliasing)
The plan downscales to exactly 32x32 with nearest-neighbor resampling
The plan reduces the colors to a limited palette
The plan verifies real transparency of the result
Expected cost is at most $0.10

evals.prompt: Сделай 6 финальных вариантов ключевого арта для страницы в Steam: бегун на крыше над неоновым городом, ночь, дождь. Максимальное качество, 16:9.
evals.expected_output: Top-tier model at high quality, 16:9; computes the total for 6 finals, sees it exceeds the $0.25 confirmation limit, asks the user with the estimate (and offers drafts-first), and does not spend before approval.
expectations: The plan computes the total expected cost for all 6 variants before generating
Because the total exceeds $0.25, the user is asked to confirm (outputs/questions.md) and the question shows the estimated cost
No paid generation is planned to run before that confirmation (no --yes or equivalent pre-approved)
A cheaper path is offered (e.g. low-quality drafts first, finals only for the picks)
The request uses a 16:9 aspect ratio
The finals use a top-tier model at high quality or above (e.g. gpt-image-2.5-sunburst/flare at high/xhigh/max)
